If a package name contains characters such as '/', '?', '#', or spaces, the resulting URL will be malformed or point to a different path, causing the request to fail or return an incorrect response. For example, a package name 'foo/bar' would become two path segments instead of one encoded segment 'foo%2Fbar'. This violates the specification.
